sql.ahj.design.detailByAhj: WITH metroAreasWithStates AS ( select lov.id as "metro_area_id", s.id as "state_id", s.state from flow.list_of_value lov inner join flow.state s on s.abbreviation = substring(lov.name from 1 for 2) where lov.parent_id = 172 and lov.archived is false ) SELECT d.*, ahj.metro_area_id, maws.state_id, maws.state AS "stateName", coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(contacts))) FROM ( SELECT c.id, c.name, c.title, c.email, c.phone_number AS "phoneNumber", c.address, c.notes, c.hours FROM brs.ahj_contact c INNER JOIN brs.ahj_design_contact adc ON c.id = adc.ahj_contact_id WHERE adc.ahj_design_id = d.id AND c.archived IS FALSE AND c.contact_type_id = 5 ) contacts), '[]' ) AS contacts, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(requirements))) FROM ( WITH open_challenge AS ( SELECT ahj_id, original_requirement_id, status_id FROM brs.ahj_requirements ar WHERE status_id = 3 AND ar.archived IS NOT TRUE ) SELECT ar.ahj_id AS "ahjId", ar.position, ar.status_id AS "statusId", ars.name status, ar.complete, ar.date_created AS "dateCreated", ar.created_by_id AS "createdById", concat(u.first_name,' ',u.last_name) AS "createdBy", ar.date_modified AS "dateModified", ar.modified_by_id AS "modifiedById", ar.archived, concat(u2.first_name,' ',u2.last_name) AS "modifiedBy", r.id, r.description, r.requirement_type_id AS "requirementTypeId", ar.original_requirement_id AS "originalRequirementId", art.name AS "requirementType", CASE WHEN oc.original_requirement_id IS NOT NULL THEN TRUE ELSE false END AS "hasOpenChallenge" FROM brs.ahj_requirements ar LEFT JOIN open_challenge oc ON oc.ahj_id = ar.ahj_id and oc.original_requirement_id = ar.original_requirement_id INNER JOIN brs.ahj_requirement r ON r.id = ar.requirement_id INNER JOIN brs.ahj_requirement_type art ON art.id = r.requirement_type_id INNER JOIN flow."user" u ON u.id = ar.created_by_id INNER JOIN flow."user" u2 ON u2.id = ar.modified_by_id INNER JOIN brs.ahj_requirement_status ars ON ars.id = ar.status_id WHERE ar.ahj_id = d.ahj_id AND art.id = 1 AND ar.status_id = 1 AND ar.archived IS NOT TRUE AND ars.archived IS NOT TRUE AND art.archived IS NOT TRUE ORDER BY ar.position ) requirements), '[]' ) AS electricalRequirements, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(requirements))) FROM ( WITH open_challenge AS ( SELECT ahj_id, original_requirement_id, status_id FROM brs.ahj_requirements ar WHERE status_id = 3 AND ar.archived IS NOT TRUE ) SELECT ar.ahj_id AS "ahjId", ar.position, ar.status_id AS "statusId", ars.name status, ar.complete, ar.date_created AS "dateCreated", ar.created_by_id AS "createdById", concat(u.first_name,' ',u.last_name) AS "createdBy", ar.date_modified AS "dateModified", ar.modified_by_id AS "modifiedById", ar.archived, concat(u2.first_name,' ',u2.last_name) AS "modifiedBy", r.id, r.description, r.requirement_type_id AS "requirementTypeId", ar.original_requirement_id "originalRequirementId", art.name AS "requirementType", CASE WHEN oc.original_requirement_id IS NOT NULL THEN TRUE ELSE false END AS "hasOpenChallenge" FROM brs.ahj_requirements ar LEFT JOIN open_challenge oc ON oc.ahj_id = ar.ahj_id and oc.original_requirement_id = ar.original_requirement_id INNER JOIN brs.ahj_requirement r ON r.id = ar.requirement_id INNER JOIN brs.ahj_requirement_type art ON art.id = r.requirement_type_id INNER JOIN flow."user" u ON u.id = ar.created_by_id INNER JOIN flow."user" u2 ON u2.id = ar.modified_by_id INNER JOIN brs.ahj_requirement_status ars ON ars.id = ar.status_id WHERE ar.ahj_id = d.ahj_id AND art.id = 2 AND ar.status_id = 1 AND ar.archived IS NOT TRUE AND ars.archived IS NOT TRUE AND art.archived IS NOT TRUE ORDER BY ar.position ) requirements), '[]' ) AS structuralRequirements, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(requirements))) FROM ( WITH open_challenge AS ( SELECT ahj_id, original_requirement_id, status_id FROM brs.ahj_requirements ar WHERE status_id = 3 AND ar.archived IS NOT TRUE ) SELECT ar.ahj_id AS "ahjId", ar.position, ar.status_id AS "statusId", ars.name status, ar.complete, ar.date_created AS "dateCreated", ar.created_by_id AS "createdById", concat(u.first_name,' ',u.last_name) AS "createdBy", ar.date_modified AS "dateModified", ar.modified_by_id AS "modifiedById", ar.archived, concat(u2.first_name,' ',u2.last_name) "modifiedBy", r.id, r.description, r.requirement_type_id AS "requirementTypeId", ar.original_requirement_id AS "originalRequirementId", art.name AS "requirementType", CASE WHEN oc.original_requirement_id IS NOT NULL THEN TRUE ELSE false END AS "hasOpenChallenge" FROM brs.ahj_requirements ar LEFT JOIN open_challenge oc ON oc.ahj_id = ar.ahj_id and oc.original_requirement_id = ar.original_requirement_id INNER JOIN brs.ahj_requirement r ON r.id = ar.requirement_id INNER JOIN brs.ahj_requirement_type art ON art.id = r.requirement_type_id INNER JOIN flow."user" u ON u.id = ar.created_by_id INNER JOIN flow."user" u2 ON u2.id = ar.modified_by_id INNER JOIN brs.ahj_requirement_status ars ON ars.id = ar.status_id WHERE ar.ahj_id = d.ahj_id AND art.id = 3 AND ar.status_id = 1 AND ar.archived IS NOT TRUE AND ars.archived IS NOT TRUE AND art.archived IS NOT TRUE ORDER BY ar.position ) requirements), '[]' ) AS designRequirements FROM brs.ahj_design d INNER JOIN brs.ahj ahj ON ahj.id = d.ahj_id LEFT JOIN metroAreasWithStates maws ON maws.metro_area_id = ahj.metro_area_id WHERE d.ahj_id = :ahjId
sql.ahj.design.createBlank: INSERT INTO brs.ahj_design (ahj_id, codes, note, archived, date_created, created_by_id) VALUES (:ahjId, null, null, false, now(), :currentUser) RETURNING id
sql.ahj.design.create: INSERT INTO brs.ahj_design (ahj_id, codes, note, reference_standards, ground_snow_load, wind_speed, roof_snow_load, archived, date_created, created_by_id) VALUES (:ahjId, :codes, :note, :referenceStandards, :groundSnowLoad, :windSpeed, :roofSnowLoad, false, now(), :currentUser)
sql.ahj.design.update: UPDATE brs.ahj_design SET ahj_id = :ahjId, codes = :codes, note = :note, reference_standards = :referenceStandards, ground_snow_load = :groundSnowLoad, wind_speed = :windSpeed, roof_snow_load = :roofSnowLoad, date_modified = now(), modified_by_id = :currentUser WHERE id = :id
sql.ahj.design.updateAllAhjDesignsInState: UPDATE brs.ahj_design SET codes = :codes, note = :note, reference_standards = :referenceStandards, ground_snow_load = :groundSnowLoad, wind_speed = :windSpeed, roof_snow_load = :roofSnowLoad, date_modified = now(), modified_by_id = :currentUser WHERE ahj_id IN (:ahjIds)
sql.ahj.design.searchAhjsByState: WITH metroAreasWithStates AS ( select lov.id as "metro_area_id", s.id as "state_id" from flow.list_of_value lov inner join flow.state s on s.abbreviation = substring(lov.name from 1 for 2) where lov.parent_id = 172 and lov.archived is false ) SELECT d.id, d.ahj_id FROM brs.ahj_design d INNER JOIN brs.ahj ahj ON ahj.id = d.ahj_id LEFT JOIN metroAreasWithStates maws ON maws.metro_area_id = ahj.metro_area_id WHERE maws.state_id = :stateId AND ahj.archived IS FALSE
